title: parthenium tomentosum var. typicum
intro: Parthenium tomentosum var. typicum, commonly known as Feverfew, is a flowering plant native to Eurasia and North Africa. The health benefits of Feverfew include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate headaches, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antihistaminic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate allergic reactions. The therapeutic actions of Feverfew include its analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. Feverfew's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, such as parthenin and cynarin, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
